survivor_dispositions.mutation: line 236 inactive-range end: close_start + [!-- --] length -> close_start - [!-- --] length
survivor_dispositions.evidence: The scanner classifies a candidate by the byte offset where the 11-byte [[/module]] token starts. The candidate closer set is therefore unchanged.

rendered_listpages_evidence.evidence: The declared rendered ListPages test passes even when generated_gate_module_close is replaced with None, Some(0), Some(1), and two arithmetic mutations. A bounded trial that added a comment-owned [[/module]] decoy to the known-false generated branch still missed the same 5 mutants, so that edit was reverted rather than being kept as false ownership evidence. The full render pipeline does not currently make this helper observable through that integration assertion. Remaining rendered shards are blocked pending an independently justified rendered behavior that actually depends on the recovery seam.

A second bounded trial added a comment-owned [[/module]] decoy, required the real first-module closer, and appended a second executable ListPages module; its unmutated task-owned-stack regression passed and asserted FIRST plus SECOND while HIDDEN stayed absent. Nevertheless the same shard-0 mutations, including replacing generated_gate_module_close with None, Some(0), and Some(1), all survived. The trial was reverted. This confirms the current full render pipeline assertion does not behaviorally own this helper even when suffix scanning is made observable at the authored fixture level.
